en: A colorized historical postcard view of a large open square bordered by multi‑story buildings and an old brick wall, with mountains rising in the background. There is a decorative street lamp in the center foreground and several trees along the left side. At the top of the image, captions in Italian read "Piazza di fiera" and "Trento," indicating the scene is the fair square in Trento, with classical urban architecture and a mountainous landscape behind.
